Asked about the "few thousand days" line in his September essay, Altman says progress could continue "for the next three or six or nine or whatever" years and that such a system "will be quite capable of doing a lot of things". The only page I opened is pickscribe's automatic transcript of the YouTube video, so the wording should be checked against the recording. I've marked it as the same claim as 2024-09-23-altman-superintelligence-few-thousand-days.toml.
- **The Bill Gates podcast doesn't count for 2024.** The official Unconfuse Me transcript aired 2024-01-11, but Gates says on the same page that it was recorded before Altman's November 2023 removal. So the "next five or ten years" line goes under 2023.
- **I lost four page openings to a scripting mistake.** I opened the Gates PDF, the YC transcript, Variety's DealBook article and the World Economic Forum's Davos 2024 page, but saved none of the text and never read the last two. I reopened the Gates and YC pages, which used up all six openings. Nothing is quoted from the Variety or WEF pages.
- **Leads I couldn't check.** News coverage says that at the New York Times DealBook Summit (2024-12-04) Altman predicted AGI sooner than most people expect, with first examples possibly in 2025. Coverage of the YC interview reports "AGI" as his answer for what he's most excited about in 2025, but the transcript I opened is cut off before the end. A book, *Our AI Journey*, quotes him on AGI in about five years and AI doing 95% of agency marketing work, with no interview date given. I saw all of these only in search snippets, so none is listed as a candidate.
- **Other dates.** The "Reflections" blog post is from January 2025, and the "by 2030" interview coverage is from September 2025.
